name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted wiki that stores pages as Markdown files on disk, with SQLite for users and search, tree navigation and a built-in Markdown editor.

alerts.message: Log in as admin with the password in LEAFWIKI_ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment variables. It only seeds the first admin account, so change it in the UI after the first login.
HTTPS is required: login and CSRF cookies are marked secure, so signing in over the plain HTTP address fails.
